const.description: Constant field; the basis for masks and blending.

params.value: The value returned at every point.

params.from: Unit-space position where the ramp is 0.
params.to: Unit-space position where the ramp is 1.

gradient_radial.description: Radial ramp, 1 at the centre and 0 at the radius; the basis for volume.

params.center: Fixed point of the operation; the unit-space origin when omitted.
params.radius: Distance at which the ramp reaches zero.

gradient_angular.description: 0→1 over one full turn around the centre; for gears and pie slices.

params.center: Fixed point of the operation; the unit-space origin when omitted.

gradient_diamond.description: Manhattan distance: 1 at the centre, 0 at `size`.

params.center: Fixed point of the operation; the unit-space origin when omitted.
params.size: Manhattan distance at which the ramp reaches zero.

noise_value.description: Lattice value noise; the cheapest noise, blocky in character.

params.freq: Cell count across the short edge.
params.seed: Derived from the node path when omitted (D5).

noise_simplex.description: Skewed-lattice noise; low axis artifacts. Cannot be used in a tileable document.

params.freq: Cell count across the short edge.
params.seed: Derived from the node path when omitted (D5).

params.freq: Cell count across the short edge.
params.seed: Derived from the node path when omitted (D5).

params.base: The UNIT field to be summed; usually a noise.
params.lacunarity: Frequency multiplier per octave. Must be an INTEGER in a tileable document.

sdf_circle.description: Circle signed distance; negative is inside.

params.center: Fixed point of the operation; the unit-space origin when omitted.

sdf_box.description: Box signed distance; negative is inside.

params.center: Fixed point of the operation; the unit-space origin when omitted.

sdf_roundBox.description: Rounded box; cannot be derived from `sdf.box`, it is a separate formula.

params.center: Fixed point of the operation; the unit-space origin when omitted.
Fixed point of the operation; the unit-space origin when omitted.
Fixed point of the operation; the unit-space origin when omitted.

sdf_line.description: Thick line segment; ends are FLAT.

sdf_capsule.description: Capsule with ROUND ends; the basis for bodies and branches.

params.center: Fixed point of the operation; the unit-space origin when omitted.

params.size: Edge length of one square in unit space.

params.freq: Cell count across the short edge.
params.duty: Ratio of the filled part to the period.

params.freq: Cell count across the short edge.
params.r: Dot radius as a ratio of the half cell width.

params.freq: Cell count across the short edge.
params.thickness: Line thickness as a ratio of the cell width.

pattern_hex.description: Hexagonal tiling; 1 at the cell centre, 0 at the edge.

params.freq: Cell count across the short edge.

rotate.description: Rotates the field; +y is down, so a positive angle turns clockwise.

params.center: Fixed point of the operation; the unit-space origin when omitted.

scale.description: Scales the field; components are separate, so it is anisotropic.

params.center: Fixed point of the operation; the unit-space origin when omitted.

skew.description: Shear; for slanted bodies and a sense of perspective.

mirror.description: Symmetry fold; works about the origin.

params.axis: Which axis is folded; `radial` gives n-fold symmetry.

repeat.description: Tiling; `mirror` mode reflects neighbouring cells and hides the seam.

params.count: Cell count across the short edge.
params.center: Fixed point of the operation; the unit-space origin when omitted.

polar.description: Polar transform: horizontal lines become rings, vertical lines become rays.

params.center: Fixed point of the operation; the unit-space origin when omitted.
params.inverse: Reverse direction: unrolls a ring into a strip.

warp.description: Warp: marble, smoke, veins, flow. Displacement comes from another field.

params.sample: Sampling mode of the displacement field; `nearest` for pixel art.

scatter.description: Replicates the source onto a jittered grid; combined with `max`.

params.source: Field to replicate; must be centred at the origin.
params.seed: Derived from the node path when omitted (D5).
params.jitter: Deviation from the grid; 0 is an exact grid, 1 is nearly random.

blur.description: Blur; separable + running sum, O(1) per pixel.

params.mode: `gauss` is approximated with three box passes.

params.radius: Which detail scale is emphasised, in UNIT space.

distance.description: Exact Euclidean distance transform; turns a raster into a SIGNED distance field.

add.description: Addition. On an SDF it grows or shrinks the shape.

sub.description: Subtraction. The way to build a contour band on an SDF.

min.description: The smaller one. On an SDF this means UNION.

max.description: The larger one. On an SDF this means INTERSECTION.

overlay.description: Raises contrast: multiply in shadows, screen in highlights.

step.description: Hard threshold: 1 when the input is at or above the edge.

smoothstep.description: Soft threshold; passing e0 > e1 yields a descending ramp.

params.e0: Input value at which the result is 0.
params.e1: Input value at which the result is 1.

remap.description: Maps one range onto another; does not clamp.

curve.description: Piecewise linear transfer curve; input outside the range clamps to the end value.

params.points: At least two `[input, output]` points. Defaults to the identity curve.

clamp.description: Clamps the value to a range.

abs.description: Absolute value; the way to build a contour from an SDF.
